    • add

      public EmployeeRepository.Employee add(String name, String role) throws IOException, SQLException
      Creates an active employee after validating name and role lengths.
      Parameters:
      name - nonblank name of at most 120 characters
      role - nonblank role of at most 50 characters
      Returns:
      the saved employee, including its generated identifier
      Throws:
      IOException - if database settings cannot be read
      SQLException - if a database operation fails
      IllegalArgumentException - if the name or role is null, blank, or too long

    • update

      public EmployeeRepository.Employee update(int employeeId, String name, String role) throws IOException, SQLException
      Changes an employee's name and role while preserving activity status and order history.
      Parameters:
      employeeId - positive identifier of the employee to update
      name - nonblank name of at most 120 characters
      role - nonblank role of at most 50 characters
      Returns:
      the updated employee
      Throws:
      IOException - if database settings cannot be read
      SQLException - if the employee no longer exists or the update fails
      IllegalArgumentException - if the identifier, name, or role is invalid
